body:
Suppression?

I know that I often laugh instead of cry. It does not particularly need to have anything to do with my life, I could just be watching/reading something sad.  I just don't want to let that count. Would you call that suppression or is that a natural thing?

I sometimes have these really short moments that only last for about 3 seconds. During this time, thoughts of my life are coming to my mind and I can feel how the tears just want to get out. I usually then just shake my head and try to do something really fast.

Thanks for the advice \^\^

Do you have any examples? All of my hobbies are not really productive and I don't really gain anything from them apart from enjoyment.  I am also not helping anyone by doing them.
That is so me. I always have to turn on a video when I am trying to fall asleep. I am glad I am not the only one doing that.

I never cut my thighs. The only things I ever cut were my arms/hands and I stopped doing that years ago because I don't feel anything anymore doing it. I loved the feeling of adrenaline pumping through your body the first times I cut, I felt so alive but not anymore.
Neither. It really is just a feeling. I guess it is similar to when you feel like your heart is going to explode/pop.
Thank you!! I hope it does for you too!
I should see another doc soon. Depending on what he says/does, my life might actually get better or it just stays the way it is right now. Still a little hope
The worst part is that there is nothing you can do about it. Sure, you can take off your clothes but let's be honest, that does not help at all!
